program.title: BSc in Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence in Science
uncertain: total_required_credits (105.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The program requires the student to follow ONE of four mutually exclusive Tracks (Applied Biosciences / Environmental Science / Information Science / Molecular Science and Cheminformatics); summing all four tracks double-counts. A realistic total is the core (pre-req 4 + required 25 + required 6 + COMP 3 = 38) plus one chosen track (Applied Biosciences 13-16, others 18-19) = ~51-57.
The MATH pre-requisite block has a 4-6 range, and the Applied Biosciences LIFS 1901/1902 block has a 0-3 range, so actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 DASC (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2026-27 intake curriculum.
